objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign authorizations for readers via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute in which the Creator of a document is automatically confirmed by default.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute through which additional personal change rights can be assigned.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for a document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for a document.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned with releaser for translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity count starts from the release of a document.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid from and Period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document; can have one or more document templates and can define periods for validity and archive duration.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of the extended validity is necessary can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration can be defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Supplement to work instructions.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Supplement to work instructions.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Entity that documents can be linked to, for example IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New object attached in the system to create documents or additional objects.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as addable to each document and reactivated with a document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system when a document reaches 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents through Override.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person involved in authorizations, workflows, distribution, acknowledgements and tasks.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader assignments, distribution lists and role-specific permissions.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing User Groups and persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Documented confirmation by users taking note of documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants during workflow-supported processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of released content or documents visible after release in the corresponding login language.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled based on distribution groups and listing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by Attachment of a new information object with selection of a corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: The corresponding document type is selected when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover can be created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to the object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: open_properties_editing
evts.description: Attachment of an object opens properties editing of the document.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata are maintained in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Metadata of a document is maintained in categories such as Master data.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with the help of an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved, conversion to PDF follows automatically.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: The current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changes to released documents result in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Authorizations for readers are assigned via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: A user is assigned as author and receives read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Additional personal change rights are assigned via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Reviewers are assigned and receive read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Releasers are assigned and receive read and write permissions.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be added to each document by Attachment of a new information object to the document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment can be added to each document by Attachment of a new information object to the document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be modified without effect on the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of Attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be archived, and actual archiving takes place after release of the current editing version.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Released Attachments are marked for archiving.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: After document creation, attribute and content maintenance and definition of document control, the approval process can be initiated.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: The 3-step release process is started by one of the co-authors or by the author.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: In the Creator workflow step, only the registered author signs the creation of the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task positively to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: Rejection during review cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: Rejection during release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users of workflow task status and existence by e-mail notifications.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Signatures of individual participants are documented in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new version is automatically created in editing status when a valid released document is revised or change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create Change proposals for a document.

evts.name: inform_author_about_change_proposal
evts.description: When a Change proposal is created, the author of the underlying document is informed by e-mail.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: If a Change proposal is scheduled for implementation, this creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: As a result of editing the Change proposal, the Creator of the proposal receives an e-mail notification.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: If a document reaches 30 days before validity expires, a request for validity extension is created by the system.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension must be processed with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared and the document remains valid in its current version.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after declaring additional validity or release of a revised version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: With release of a new revised version or declared suspension, the validity extension process is automatically terminated.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: After Attachment of the request for AKS, the workflow for processing the request is started automatically.

evts.name: check_aks_request
evts.description: The Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the AKS process.

evts.name: review_aks
evts.description: Reviewers review the AKS.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Releasers approve the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: After declaration of Out of force, the last valid and approved version of the document is given the status Out of force.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except for the archive group are revoked when documents are archived.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The Creator of the request for reactivation confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: A new version of the document is created and original status is restored except for version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Equippments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User Groups and persons are assigned to Distribution for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Each recipient confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team_of_acknowledgements
evts.description: The author team receives an overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: User and role-specific dashboards are filled based on distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Role-specific evaluation reports and searches are available for documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released content of DHC VISION into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: assign_translation_participants
evts.description: Participants for checking and releasing the translation are assigned in the properties dialog of the document.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, clients in which the document is visible or not can be specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the client to make a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference_to_original_document
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created for a local addition.
